conflicts.description: Contradictory reports on whether short-range order (SRO) affects the mechanical properties of NiCoCr MEA. One group reports a ~25% yield strength increase due to SRO, while others argue SRO has negligible or no measurable influence on yield strength.

evidence.quote: In contrast to the work of Zhang et al. [240] described above, Inoue et al. [255] and Yin et al. [256] argued that the SRO displays inappreciable or has no measurable influence on the yield strength of NiCoCr MEA.
